docs.summary: Static operators for manipulating GeometryData (BMesh-like) structures. All operations modify the mesh in-place. Inspired by Blender's BMesh operators.

members.name: AttributeLerp
members.signature: public static void AttributeLerp(GeometryData mesh, GeometryData.Vertex destination, GeometryData.Vertex v1, GeometryData.Vertex v2, float t)

docs.summary: Set all attributes in destination vertex to attr[v1] * (1 - t) + attr[v2] * t. Linearly interpolates all vertex attributes between two vertices.

params.destination: The vertex to write interpolated attributes to.
params.t: Interpolation factor (0 = v1, 1 = v2). Unclamped: values outside [0, 1] extrapolate.

members.signature: public static (GeometryData.Vertex, GeometryData.Vertex) GetCanonicalEdge(GeometryData.Vertex v1, GeometryData.Vertex v2)

docs.summary: Scale specified faces uniformly from their centers.

members.name: Translate
members.signature: public static void Translate(GeometryData mesh, Float3 offset)

docs.summary: Translate the entire mesh by an offset.

docs.summary: Translate specified faces by an offset.

members.name: RemoveVerticesOnPlanePositiveSide
members.signature: public static void RemoveVerticesOnPlanePositiveSide(GeometryData mesh, Plane plane, float epsilon = 0.0001f)

docs.summary: Remove all geometry on the positive side of a plane (where the normal points). Vertices exactly on the plane are kept.

params.plane: The plane to use for culling.
params.epsilon: Tolerance for considering a vertex on the plane.

members.name: RemoveVerticesOnPlaneNegativeSide
members.signature: public static void RemoveVerticesOnPlaneNegativeSide(GeometryData mesh, Plane plane, float epsilon = 0.0001f)

docs.summary: Remove all geometry on the negative side of a plane (opposite to where the normal points). Vertices exactly on the plane are kept.

params.plane: The plane to use for culling.
params.epsilon: Tolerance for considering a vertex on the plane.

members.name: Subdivide
members.signature: public static void Subdivide(GeometryData mesh)

docs.summary: Subdivide all faces in the mesh without smoothing. After subdivision, all faces are quads. Attempts to interpolate all attributes. Note: Modifies edge IDs during operation.

members.name: SquarifyQuads
members.signature: public static void SquarifyQuads(GeometryData mesh, float rate = 1.0f, bool uniformLength = false)

docs.summary: Try to make quad faces as square as possible. This assumes the mesh is only made of quads. Can be called iteratively for better results.

params.mesh: The mesh to squarify (must contain only quad faces).
params.rate: Speed at which faces are squarified. Higher is faster but may overshoot.
params.uniformLength: Whether to uniformize the size of all quads.

members.name: Merge
members.signature: public static void Merge(GeometryData mesh, GeometryData other)

docs.summary: Merge another mesh into this one. All vertices, edges, and faces from the other mesh are added to this mesh. Attributes are copied. Note: Modifies vertex IDs of the source mesh during operation.

params.other: The source mesh to merge in.

members.name: SplitEdge
members.signature: public static GeometryData.Vertex SplitEdge(GeometryData mesh, GeometryData.Edge edge, GeometryData.Vertex fromVertex, float factor, out GeometryData.Edge newEdge)

docs.summary: Split an edge at a given interpolation factor, creating a new vertex.
docs.returns: The newly created vertex at the split point.

params.fromVertex: One of the edge's vertices (defines the "from" end).
params.factor: Interpolation factor (0.0 = at fromVertex, 1.0 = at the other vertex).
params.newEdge: Output: The newly created edge (from the new vertex to the non-fromVertex end).

members.name: SplitFace
members.signature: public static GeometryData.Face? SplitFace(GeometryData mesh, GeometryData.Face face, GeometryData.Vertex vert1, GeometryData.Vertex vert2, out GeometryData.Edge? newEdge)

docs.summary: Split a face along two vertices, creating a new face and edge.
docs.returns: The newly created face, or null if the split fails.

params.vert2: Second vertex of the split (must be different from vert1 and not adjacent).
params.newEdge: Output: The newly created edge connecting the two vertices.

members.name: BisectPlane
members.signature: public static void BisectPlane(GeometryData mesh, Plane plane, float epsilon = 0.0001f, bool snapToPlane = true)

docs.summary: Bisect a mesh with a plane, splitting edges and faces that cross the plane.

params.plane: The plane to bisect with (Normal.X, Normal.Y, Normal.Z, Distance).
params.epsilon: Tolerance for considering a vertex on the plane.
params.snapToPlane: If true, snap vertices very close to the plane onto it.

members.name: Nearpoint
members.signature: public static GeometryData.Vertex? Nearpoint(GeometryData mesh, GeometryData.AttributeValue value, string attrName)

docs.summary: Find the vertex whose attribute value is closest to the given value. Uses Euclidean distance for comparison.
docs.returns: The vertex with the closest attribute value, or null if attribute doesn't exist.

params.attrName: The name of the attribute to compare.

members.name: RecalculateNormals
members.signature: public static void RecalculateNormals(GeometryData mesh)

docs.summary: Recalculate normals for all vertices based on adjacent face normals. Creates or updates a "normal" Float attribute (3 dimensions) on vertices.

params.mesh: The mesh to calculate normals for.

members.name: Triangulate
members.signature: public static void Triangulate(GeometryData mesh)

docs.summary: Splits every face with more than three corners into triangles, by ear clipping in the face's plane so concave faces come out right. Each triangle keeps the face attributes and the loop attributes of its corners.

members.name: ExtrudeFaces
members.signature: public static void ExtrudeFaces(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> facesToExtrude, float distance, ExtrudeMode mode = ExtrudeMode.AlongNormals)

docs.summary: Extrude a collection of faces outward (or inward) along their normals. Creates new geometry by duplicating the faces and connecting them with wall faces. Faces joined to a selected face by hidden edges are extruded with it, since they are one face.

params.distance: The extrusion distance (positive = outward along normal, negative = inward).
params.mode: The extrusion mode: AlongNormals - vertices move along averaged normals (shared vertices), AverageNormal - all vertices move along average of all face normals (shared vertices), PerFace - each face gets its own vertices (no sharing).

members.name: InsetFaces
members.signature: public static void InsetFaces(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> facesToInset, float thickness, InsetMode mode = InsetMode.Shared, InsetMeasure measure = InsetMeasure.Fraction)

docs.summary: Inset a collection of faces, shrinking each inside its own outline and joining it to the old outline with wall faces. Faces joined by hidden edges are inset as one face.

params.thickness: How far to inset, as `measure` says.
params.mode: Whether the faces are inset together as one region, or each on its own.
params.measure: Whether the thickness is a fraction of the way to the face centre, or a distance.

members.name: BevelEdges
members.signature: public static int BevelEdges(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges, float width, int segments = 1, float profile = 0.5f)

docs.summary: Bevel edges between two faces, replacing each with a strip of faces. Any number of edges can meet at a corner, which is capped. Face, loop and edge attributes carry over to the new faces, with loop attributes such as texture coordinates sampled across the face they came from. Edges between faces in one plane are skipped. Throws `InvalidOperationException` when the width reaches other geometry or the surface is not manifold.
docs.returns: How many strip faces were added.

params.edges: The edges to bevel, each with a face on both sides.
params.width: How far from the edge the bevel reaches along each face.
params.segments: How many strips an edge becomes. One is a flat chamfer, more make a rounded edge.
params.profile: The shape of the rounding. 0 is flat, 0.5 a circle, higher is squarer.

members.name: BevelVertices
members.signature: public static int BevelVertices(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Vertex> verticesToBevel, float offset = 0.3f, bool relative = true)

docs.summary: Bevel one or more vertices by replacing each with a small face. A new vertex is placed on every edge around a beveled vertex and they are joined by the face. Neighbouring vertices can be beveled together, and vertices on an open border are cut too. Face, loop and edge attributes carry over to the new faces. Throws `InvalidOperationException` when the offset reaches past an edge or the surface is not manifold.

params.offset: How far along each edge to place the new vertices.
params.relative: When true the offset is a fraction of each edge's length, from 0 to 1 exclusive. When false it is a distance.

members.name: WeldVertices
members.signature: public static int WeldVertices(GeometryData mesh, float threshold = 0.0001f)

docs.summary: Weld vertices that are within a distance threshold, merging them into single vertices. This is useful for cleaning up geometry with duplicate or nearly-duplicate vertices. Attributes are averaged based on the merged vertices.
docs.returns: The number of vertices that were welded (removed).

params.mesh: The mesh to weld vertices in.
params.threshold: Maximum distance between vertices to be welded together.

members.name: WeldVerticesAtPositions
members.signature: public static int WeldVerticesAtPositions(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<Float3> targetPositions, float threshold)

docs.summary: Weld vertices at specific positions by merging all vertices within threshold distance of each target. This is useful for welding specific problem areas without affecting the entire mesh.
docs.returns: The number of vertices that were welded (removed).

params.mesh: The mesh to weld vertices in.
params.targetPositions: Positions around which to weld vertices.
params.threshold: Maximum distance from target positions to weld vertices.

members.name: Simplify
members.signature: public static SimplifyResult Simplify(GeometryData mesh, SimplifyOptions options)

docs.summary: Reduce the triangle count by collapsing vertices onto their neighbours, cheapest first by quadric error. No vertex is ever created or moved, so every vertex and loop attribute keeps an authored value. Seams (loops at one vertex with different attributes), borders and region outlines are only ever simplified along themselves. When anything collapses the mesh comes back as triangles, faces with more corners included. When nothing does it is left untouched.

params.mesh: The mesh to simplify in place.
params.options: Target, error limit, attribute weights and what to preserve.

members.name: DrawSegments
members.signature: public static void DrawSegments(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyList<(Float3 A, Float3 B)> segments, Float3? planeNormal, Float3 viewDirection, int material)

docs.summary: Draws lines into the mesh. Any closed loop they make on a plane becomes a face, and lines across an existing face split it.

params.segments: The lines, as pairs of end points.
params.planeNormal: The plane the lines were drawn on, when it is known.
params.viewDirection: Where the viewer looks, so a new face in empty space faces them.
params.material: The material for faces made in empty space.

members.name: ConnectVertices
members.signature: public static int ConnectVertices(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices, int material, Float3 viewDirection)

docs.summary: Joins vertices that share a face with new edges, in the order they run around it. Returns how many edges were drawn.

members.name: IntersectFaces
members.signature: public static int IntersectFaces(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face>? only = null)

docs.summary: Cuts faces where they pass through each other, adding the edges of the crossing. With a selection only those faces are cut against the rest. Returns how many crossing lines were added.

members.name: PushPull
members.signature: public static void PushPull(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face> region, float distance, bool keepBase = false)

docs.summary: Pushes or pulls a flat region along its normal. Walls are added around it, walls that line up with faces beside them merge into them, and faces that end up overlapping facing opposite ways cancel, so pushing through a solid cuts a hole. A region standing on its own keeps its base, making a solid.

params.region: Faces in one plane, usually a whole face with the faces joined to it by hidden edges.
params.distance: How far to move it along its normal.
params.keepBase: Leave the region where it was too, so the result is a new solid on top of it.

members.name: MoveVertices
members.signature: public static void MoveVertices(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices, Float3 delta)

docs.summary: Moves vertices, then folds faces bent out of flat and rebuilds the planes they touch.

members.name: TransformVertices
members.signature: public static void TransformVertices(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices, Func<Float3, Float3> transform)

docs.summary: Moves vertices by any transform, then folds and rebuilds like [`MoveVertices`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryOperators~MoveVertices).

members.name: ScaleVertices
members.signature: public static void ScaleVertices(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices, Float3 pivot, Float3 factors, Quaternion frame)

docs.summary: Scales vertices about a pivot, per axis of a rotated frame, then folds and rebuilds like [`MoveVertices`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryOperators~MoveVertices).

members.name: MergeVertices
members.signature: public static void MergeVertices(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices, Float3 target)

docs.summary: Joins vertices into one at a point. Faces that collapse away with them are removed.

members.name: CollapseEdges
members.signature: public static int CollapseEdges(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges)

docs.summary: Collapses each connected group of edges to a single point at its centre. Returns how many vertices were joined.

members.name: MergeByDistance
members.signature: public static int MergeByDistance(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Vertex>? scope, float distance)

docs.summary: Joins vertices within a distance of each other onto their average and rebuilds the flat faces around them. Unlike [`WeldVertices`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Geometry.GeometryOperators~WeldVertices) clusters chain, so a row of close vertices becomes one. With no scope every vertex is considered. Returns how many vertices were joined.

members.name: CopyFaces
members.signature: public static List<GeometryData.Vertex> CopyFaces(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face> faces, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Edge> edges, Func<Float3, Float3> transform, bool flip = false)

docs.summary: Copies faces and loose edges through a transform. Copies that land on existing faces merge into them like drawn geometry. Returns the new vertices.

params.faces: The faces to copy, with any faces joined to them by hidden edges.
params.transform: Where each point of the copy goes.
params.flip: Reverse the copies, for transforms that mirror.

members.name: Mirror
members.signature: public static List<GeometryData.Vertex> Mirror(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face> faces, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Edge> edges, Plane plane)

docs.summary: A mirrored copy of faces and edges across a plane, wound to face the same way as the originals. Returns the new vertices.

members.name: Array
members.signature: public static void Array(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face> faces, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Edge> edges, int copies, Func<Float3, int, Float3> transform)

docs.summary: Copies faces and edges several times, each copy by the transform for its step, starting at 1.

members.name: DeleteFaces
members.signature: public static void DeleteFaces(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> faces)

docs.summary: Deletes faces, with the rest of any face they are joined to by hidden edges. Their edges stay.

members.name: DeleteEdges
members.signature: public static void DeleteEdges(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges)

docs.summary: Deletes edges. An edge between two faces lying flat together merges them, any other edge takes the faces it bounds with it. Lines left running straight through a vertex are joined back up.

members.name: DeleteVertices
members.signature: public static void DeleteVertices(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Vertex> vertices)

docs.summary: Deletes vertices with their faces. One sitting in the middle of a straight line just joins the line back up.

members.name: SubdivideEdges
members.signature: public static List<GeometryData.Vertex> SubdivideEdges(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges, int cuts)

docs.summary: Adds evenly spaced vertices along edges, splitting every face that uses them. Returns the new vertices.

members.name: ExtrudeEdges
members.signature: public static List<GeometryData.Vertex> ExtrudeEdges(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Edge> edges, Float3 offset, int material)

docs.summary: Pushes edges out into a strip of new quads, joining each edge to a copy moved by the offset. Returns the copies of the vertices.

members.name: FillLoop
members.signature: public static int FillLoop(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges, int material)

docs.summary: Closes a loop of edges with a face. A bent loop becomes triangles joined by hidden edges. Returns how many faces were made.

members.name: FoldFaces
members.signature: public static void FoldFaces(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> faces)

docs.summary: Splits faces into triangles joined by hidden edges, so each piece can be bent on its own while it still reads as one face.

members.name: FlipFaces
members.signature: public static void FlipFaces(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> faces)

docs.summary: Reverses the way faces point. Faces joined by hidden edges flip together.

members.name: OrientFaces
members.signature: public static int OrientFaces(GeometryData mesh)

docs.summary: Turns faces round where neighbours disagree about which way is out, so each surface is consistent, and makes closed shells face outwards. Returns how many faces were flipped.

members.name: SoftenPolyline
members.signature: public static void SoftenPolyline(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyList<Float3> points, bool closed)

docs.summary: Marks the edges along a run of points as soft, the way a drawn circle is one smooth curve.

members.name: SoftenByAngle
members.signature: public static int SoftenByAngle(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges, float degrees)

docs.summary: Makes edges soft where their two faces meet at less than an angle in degrees, and hard where they do not. Returns how many changed.

members.name: SetSoft
members.signature: public static void SetSoft(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Edge> edges, bool soft)

docs.summary: Sets whether edges are soft.

members.name: Paint
members.signature: public static void Paint(GeometryData mesh, IEnumerable<GeometryData.Face> faces, int material)

docs.summary: Gives faces a material and drops any texture mapping they had, so the material's own projection applies.

members.name: FollowMe
members.signature: public static int FollowMe(GeometryData mesh, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Face> profile, IReadOnlyCollection<GeometryData.Edge> path)

docs.summary: Sweeps a flat region along a path of edges, like SketchUp's Follow Me. Corners are mitred so the walls stay flat, and the ends are capped unless the path loops. Returns how many faces were made.
